description: This file defines the DimensionMismatchException class, which extends MathIllegalNumberException, representing an exception thrown when two dimensions differ in a mathematical context within the Apache Commons Math library. It includes constructors to initialize the exception with specific mismatch details and a method to retrieve the expected dimension.

classes.name: DimensionMismatchException
classes.description: An exception indicating that two dimensions do not match, extending MathIllegalNumberException to include specific mismatch details.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with specific localized message and mismatch dimensions.

methods.name: getDimension
methods.description: Returns the expected dimension associated with this exception.
